desc:
🚑 Become a Paramedic! Respond to emergencies, drive ambulances, save lives, and build your own hospital! ❤️‍🩹

🚨 Drive ambulances with working sirens and traffic that moves aside!
🩺 Respond to 25+ emergencies, including crashes, fires, drowning, and more!
🧰 Use medical tools to treat and rescue patients!
🏥 Build and upgrade your own hospital!
👩‍⚕️ Hire workers to care for your patients!
⭐ Unlock new equipment, earn rewards, and level up!
🎮 Play on PC, Mobile & Console!

👍 LIKE THE GAME & JOIN THE GROUP!
